svg.title: Abliteration in the residual stream
svg.desc: Animated schematic. Harmless and harmful prompt activations form two clusters. The refusal direction r-hat is the difference of their means, made orthogonal to the harmless mean. Projecting r-hat out of the weights moves harmful activations onto the plane orthogonal to r-hat, while harmless activations barely move.
svg.text: Schematic: a 2-D slice of the 3,840-dimensional residual stream

g.text: Average the residual stream over 400 harmful
and 400 harmless prompts, layer by layer. The
difference of the two means points at refusal.
Drop its component along the harmless mean
Project it out of the weights
W ← W − λ r̂ r̂ᵀ W for each attn.o_proj and
mlp.down_proj. Those layers stop writing along
r̂, so harmful activations lose that component.
